7cfe2a745aef032772c40297126b552c3be219e7.definition: 운전자가 제동 페달을 밟은 순간부터 차량이 완전히 멈출 때까지 이동하는 거리. 노면 상태와 차량 속도에 따라 달라진다.
7cfe2a745aef032772c40297126b552c3be219e7.gloss: 운전자가 제동 페달을 밟은 순간부터 차량이 멈출 때까지 이동하는 거리.

7cfe2a745aef032772c40297126b552c3be219e7.definition: Distância que o veículo percorre entre o momento em que o motorista aciona o freio e o momento em que ele para. Ela depende da velocidade, da aderência e das condições da pista.
7cfe2a745aef032772c40297126b552c3be219e7.gloss: Distância percorrida pelo carro desde o acionamento do freio até a parada completa.

7cfe2a745aef032772c40297126b552c3be219e7.definition: Jarak yang ditempuh kendaraan sejak pedal rem ditekan hingga kendaraan berhenti. Jarak ini dipengaruhi kondisi jalan, cuaca, dan beban kendaraan.
7cfe2a745aef032772c40297126b552c3be219e7.gloss: Jarak yang ditempuh kendaraan sejak pedal rem ditekan hingga berhenti.

7cfe2a745aef032772c40297126b552c3be219e7.definition: ระยะทางที่รถแล่นไปตั้งแต่เริ่มกดเบรกจนกระทั่งรถหยุด ซึ่งระยะนี้ขึ้นอยู่กับความเร็ว สภาพถนน และประสิทธิภาพของเบรก
7cfe2a745aef032772c40297126b552c3be219e7.gloss: ระยะที่รถเคลื่อนที่ตั้งแต่ผู้ขับขี่แตะเบรกจนรถหยุดนิ่ง

7cfe2a745aef032772c40297126b552c3be219e7.definition: Sürücü frene bastığı andan aracın tamamen durduğu ana kadar kat edilen mesafedir. Islak yol gibi yüzey koşullarında bu mesafe artar.
7cfe2a745aef032772c40297126b552c3be219e7.gloss: Sürücü frene bastığı andan aracın durduğu ana kadar kat edilen yol.

7cfe2a745aef032772c40297126b552c3be219e7.translation: Islak yolda frenleme mesafesi kuru yolda olduğundan daha uzundur.
บนถนนเปียก ระยะเบรกยาวกว่าบนถนนแห้ง
Di jalan basah, jarak berhenti lebih panjang daripada di jalan kering.
Na pista molhada, a distância de frenagem é maior do que na pista seca.
젖은 도로에서는 마른 도로보다 제동거리가 길다.
濡れた路面では、乾いた路面より制動距離が長くなる。

7cfe2a745aef032772c40297126b552c3be219e7.text: On a wet road the braking distance is longer than on a dry road.
7cfe2a745aef032772c40297126b552c3be219e7.translation: Trên đường ướt, quãng đường phanh dài hơn so với trên đường khô.
